description:
what I watch helps you keep track of the series you're currently watching.
Built for privacy and simplicity, the app operates entirely on your device — no accounts, no sign-ups, no data sharing, no social bullshits. Everything stays local.
Series and episode data is sourced from the TVmaze public API.
⚠️ THIS APP IS NOT FOR WATCHING TV SHOWS, IT ONLY TRACKS YOUR PROGRESS ⚠️
Features
• Search series in the TVmaze database
• Track your preferred series
• Mark watched episodes
• All your data is saved locally on your device
• No permission needed
• Backup & restore with SQLite files: it's your data do what you want with it
